title: Pervasive binding of the stem cell transcription factor SALL4 shapes the chromatin landscape
authors: Kashyap Chhatbar; Sara Giuliani; Timo Quante; Beatrice Alexander-Howden; Jim Selfridge; Jacky Guy; Tatsiana Auchynnikava; Christos Spanos; Tricia Mathieson; Guido Sanguinetti; Adrian Bird; Raphaël Pantier
one_liner_zh: 该文研究干细胞转录因子SALL4通过AT富集基序的分散结合调控染色质与基因表达，虽聚焦TF-DNA结合但主要依赖实验与可解释机器学习，缺乏三维互作建模或物理模拟，方法上部分契合AI但深度有限。
abstract: Mechanistic understanding of how gene activity is regulated has focussed on the roles of transcription factors at promoters and enhancers, whereas mechanisms capable of globally fine-tuning gene expression through dispersed binding across large genomic regions have received less attention. Here we provide evidence that the essential stem cell transcription factor SALL4 modulates gene expression according to DNA base composition by reading the frequency of its AT-rich target motifs. Using an acute depletion strategy, we establish that SALL4-repressed genes localise to AT-rich genomic domains with high levels of dispersed SALL4 occupancy. While SALL4 is localised within peaks and distributed broadly across the genome, explainable machine learning revealed that its occupancy across the gene body is a strong predictor of transcriptional output. We observed rapid increases in chromatin accessibility and histone acetylation independent of transcriptional activity, suggesting that SALL4 primarily acts upon chromatin, while transcriptional changes are secondary. Accordingly, preventing SALL4 from recruiting the histone deacetylase and nucleosome remodelling corepressor NuRD mimicked a Sall4 -null phenotype in stem cells and animal models. Our findings reveal that SALL4’s interpretation of DNA sequence optimises the global epigenome and transcriptome, a process integral to maintaining the stem cell gene expression programme.
abstract_zh: 对基因活性调控机制的 mechanistic 理解一直聚焦于转录因子在启动子和增强子中的作用，而通过在大基因组区域分散结合来全局微调基因表达的机制则受到的关注较少。在此，我们提供证据表明，必需干细胞转录因子 SALL4 通过读取其富含 AT 的靶基序频率，根据 DNA 碱基组成调节基因表达。利用急性耗竭策略，我们确定 SALL4 抑制的基因定位于富含 AT 的基因组区域，这些区域具有高水平的分散 SALL4 占据。虽然 SALL4 定位于峰内并在基因组中广泛分布，但可解释机器学习揭示，其在基因体上的占据是转录输出的强预测因子。我们观察到染色质可及性和组蛋白乙酰化的快速增加，且独立于转录活性，这表明 SALL4 主要作用于染色质，而转录变化是次要的。相应地，阻止 SALL4 招募组蛋白去乙酰化酶和核小体重塑共抑制因子 NuRD 在干细胞和动物模型中模拟了 Sall4 缺失表型。我们的发现揭示，SALL4 对 DNA 序列的解读优化了全局表观基因组和转录组，这一过程对维持干细胞基因表达程序至关重要。
